lore_anchors.definition: An innate supernatural ability possessed by certain individuals in the Dao-Twisted World, capable of warping local reality to create a bounded domain where a different version of the world exists. It is linked to a higher entity called the Three-Bodied Old One.
The capital of the Great Qi, which physically overlays with the Upper Capital of the Great Liang. Its nature shifts depending on proximity to the Heart-Mandala bearer.
A phantom dynasty that, under the Heart-Mandala’s influence, is perceived as the real realm, while the Great Liang is dismissed as a false illusion.
The “real” dynasty outside the Heart-Mandala’s influence, considered by most characters to be the actual world.
A mysterious higher entity mentioned in connection to the Heart-Mandala, likely a cosmic or primordial being that grants or empowers such abilities.
A grotesque parasitic entity that, when ingested, suppresses Li Huowang’s hallucinations. It is harvested from the alchemical remnants of twisted cultivation.
